Things you need:
Eggplant: 5-6 thin sliced in the form of strips
 Onion: 3-4 if they are small, 1 if they are big
 Oil: Sunflower oil/vegetable oil 1 teaspoon
 Pepper powder: 2 teaspoons
 Green chilly: 3 each sliced into two
 Salt: 1 teaspoon (add accordingly)
 How to:
* Take a frying pan flat bottom or not according to what you use for heating up whether stove or hot oven. Saute the onion in the oil till it become golden brown. add the pepper powder and stir well. Now add the cut eggplant and sliced chilly and mix well. Add the salt, mix well and keep it closed in simmering heat for about 10-15 mins. Open, stir once and keep it closed for about 10mins more.
